text: A natural transformation between functors F, G: A → B (Segal types) in simplicial TT is:
choices: an element of the hom type hom_{A→B}(F, G) — a directed path in the function type
a family of morphisms F(a) → G(a) plus coherence proofs
explanation: In synthetic category theory, natural transformations = directed paths in function types. This collapses the definition: α: hom_{A→B}(F,G) is a term of the hom type, and components α(a): hom_B(F(a), G(a)) are its evaluations.
